inbodydescription.para: NOTE: No need for checking if requirement is allocated to the caller subsystem; mere presence of a requirement on the given node from caller subsystem is enough to pass the access criteria.

briefdescription.para: Validate the clear_type field of a SET_NODE_ACCESS word2.

parameterdescription.para: The SET_NODE_ACCESS word2 value to validate

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS for a defined clear type; XST_INVALID_PARAM for the reserved encoding.
Kept as a small pure function so the caller can invoke it independently over a genuine double (volatile) read of word2 for glitch redundancy.

briefdescription.para: Validate the access field of a SET_NODE_ACCESS word2.

parameterdescription.para: The SET_NODE_ACCESS word2 value to validate

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS for a valid access encoding; XST_INVALID_PARAM for ACCESS_RESERVED (0) or any encoding >= ACCESS_TYPE_MAX.
Rejecting reserved values ensures they can never be stored. See XPmAccess_ValidateClearType for why this is a function.

briefdescription.para: Add a new node access entry to the "Node Access Table".

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or error code

This function implements an prepend/update behavior:
If an aperture with the same offset and size exists, it updates the access field
If it doesn't exist, it prepends the new aperture to the list
